run_replay_action_log: run the replay action log module with a logfile and trajectory JSON to verify robot states
run_replay_cli: run the CLI tool with --logfile and --trajectory flags to replay and verify recorded actions
test_replay_action_log: test the replay_action_log function by providing a pickle logfile and trajectory to verify states
review_replay_action_log: review the replay_action_log function that replays actions from a pickle log and computes cumulative reward
summarize_add_arguments: summarize the add_arguments function that adds logfile and trajectory CLI arguments to an argparse parser
